PREDICTION_SCORE.score_range: 0..100, assuming normalized source features and configured weights sum to 100
PREDICTION_SCORE.decision: Candidates are sorted by score descending after all blockers pass. A candidate is PREDICT only when at least one candidate passes every official blocker; otherwise decision is SKIP.
PREDICTION_SCORE.ui_api_source: Journal API returns prediction_journal.prediction_score; candidate preview/gate API exposes selected_candidate/candidate.predictionScore. UI prioritizes gate candidate predictionScore and falls back to persisted journal prediction_score.
PREDICTION_SCORE.ui_api_evidence: src/predictions/service.ts persists item.predictionScore and scoreComponents from the evaluation into prediction_journal; preview/gate serialization preserves candidate.predictionScore; src/app.ts maps prediction.prediction_score to predictionScore; src/dashboard.ts selects candidate predictionScore first and journal prediction_score as fallback.
PREDICTION_SCORE.score_zero_fallback: No blanket score=0 fallback in scorePrediction. Missing historical hit rate and sample size contribute 0 to their weighted components. Odds-analysis missing market returns an empty analysis and prediction evaluation returns SKIP with NO_ODDS_ANALYSIS; the gate inspector may display 0 as a presentation-only current value when candidate is absent.

SCORE_FORMULA.rounding: Each component and final total rounded to 2 decimal places; no further normalization. Probability fields use 0..1 fractions.
SCORE_FORMULA.missing: Null historicalHitRate is treated as zero for score contribution; sample size zero also contributes zero reliability. Missing odds yields no candidates rather than an invented candidate.
SCORE_FORMULA.similarity: Similarity is a hard eligibility/distance filter and tie-order input through nearest-first sample selection; it is not a direct score weight. Average similarity is reported, not weighted into score.
SCORE_FORMULA.compatibility: Market type/name/line/selection must match exactly. Odds/probability/movement/agreement must stay within configured tolerances; incompatible observations are excluded.
SCORE_FORMULA.same_competition: Use same competition examples if at least minimumHistoricalSample=30 settled binary examples remain; otherwise use global supported-competition matches. Global fallback is permitted by current semantics.
SCORE_FORMULA.sample: minimumHistoricalSample=30 settled binary outcomes; targetHistoricalSample=100 for reliability scaling; maximumHistoricalExamples=250. PUSH and VOID are excluded from settled denominator and the minimum settled count.

MISSING_DATA.reason: No DATABASE_URL is configured in this checkout; only .env.example is present. No production database connection was attempted with absent credentials.
MISSING_DATA.note: A structured match-level gap count requires a read-only query against the target production database. This report does not fabricate values. Current engine's explicit evaluation reasons include NO_ODDS_ANALYSIS, ODDS_NOT_ELIGIBLE, LOW_DATA_QUALITY, LOW_MODEL_CONFIDENCE, INSUFFICIENT_BOOKMAKERS, INSUFFICIENT_COMPLETE_STATES, MOVEMENT_NOT_SUPPORTED, INSUFFICIENT_HISTORICAL_SAMPLE, LOW_PREDICTION_SCORE, UNSUPPORTED_MARKET, and lock-window conditions.

SIMILARITY_COVERAGE.reason: Prediction evidence keeps at most 250 compatible historical examples; current prediction formula does not apply a separate numeric similarity threshold. A configured tolerance box filters candidates. The 30 neighbor display value belongs to a separate odds-intelligence UI path and is not the prediction evidence sample size.

LOOKAHEAD_PROTECTION.odds_snapshots_require: captured_at < match kickoff_at and captured_at <= generated_at
LOOKAHEAD_PROTECTION.safety_note: Historically imported public CSV data without verified exact observation timestamps is marked research-only and is not eligible for official predictions.

DATA_BACKFILL_RECOMMENDATION.recommendation: Do not choose one global season window without DB coverage measurements. Produce per-league/market rolling 1-, 2-, and 3-season reports first; enable a window only where historical observations have verified pre-kickoff timing, exact market identity, settled result, and useful neighbor distance. Prefer same-competition matches; keep cross-competition fallback explicit and audit its share.
